item.title: Is everything pre-fixed? The timeless debate on birth, death, and destiny
item.description: From ancient scriptures to modern philosophy, one question has echoed through human consciousness for centuries: Is everything in life pre-fixed—our birth, our journey, and even our death? While science explains how we are born and why we die, spirituality seeks to answer the deeper why now. item.title: Time … Thy name is a great healer
item.description: Once a problem befalls a man, he thinks it is the end of life. On the contrary, when he is overwhelmed with happiness, he perceives that he has become the unconquerable master of the world, and that this privileged aura will never fade—it will last forever. item.title: ‘Nayanam’ review: Well-crafted narrative
item.description: Nayanam, streaming on Zee5, is a Telugu crime thriller web series that sees Varun Sandesh delivering one of the finest performances of his career. Directed and written by Swathi Prakash, the series revolves around Dr. Nayan (Sandesh), an ophthalmologist who secretly uses a special fluid and glasses to spy on his patients’ lives for four minutes.
